milestone: Checked Unicode scalar indexing of immutable CPU Strings

implementation.source: text[index] accepts int32/uint32/int64/uint64 and returns one-scalar String; no byte indexing or Char type
implementation.frontend: Track scalar extents through literals, immutable bindings including branch scopes, known concatenations and indexing results; reject known negative/high/empty/out-of-range indexes; dynamic values keep runtime checks
implementation.IR: Dedicated StringIndex with strict input/index/result identity; signed/unsigned 32-bit indexes extend correctly to the private 64-bit checked runtime call
implementation.runtime: Optional scalar selection piggybacks on complete strict UTF-8 validation and publishes boundaries only after a successful full scan; no invalid tail is skipped
implementation.ownership: Copy one to four bytes into new invocation-owned storage; independent parent/result allocations; retain results across invocation settlement; alias-safe descriptor output
implementation.faults: BoundsFault for missing scalars, RuntimeFault for malformed descriptors/UTF-8, AllocationFault for result storage failure; no partially published selection/result
implementation.limits: Slicing, String worker/callback captures and String array/record elements remain gated; ordinary indexing of private borrowed task diagnostics hits the explicit String module gate

coverage: ASCII/Persian/combining marks/emoji/joiner/NUL/BOM/U+10FFFF selection at exact scalar boundaries
All four integer widths, end/negative/high dynamic indexes, empty values, compile-time literal/binding/branch/concat/result bounds diagnostics
Imported/chained values, sequential callbacks, single source/index evaluation, left-to-right fault order and short circuit
Independent result after parent release, retained result after context settlement, aliased output, allocation failure and owner balance
Malformed complete descriptors and hidden invalid UTF-8 tails reject before result allocation
Failed/cancelled UTF-8 scans leave boundary/count sentinels unchanged; indexing position zero still observes cancellation during the full scan
Wrong input/index/result types, bad arity, forged IR and task diagnostic indexing rejected
String validation/equality/concat/length regressions, core semantics/continuations and numeric array indexing frontend/worker regressions
qualification.scope: Focused CPU qualification; optimized applies to generated programs/harnesses with the existing core runtime archive. No GPU or worker String implementation claim.
qualification.build_notes: A final fresh run followed completion of scalar-extent tracking for nested bindings. No production changes or rebuilds during this final qualification.

native/lib/CheckedABI.cpp.change: Add checked String scalar indexing call; existing numeric rules unchanged
